gates.mjs:24-28 hashes almost all inherited process.env values. integration.mjs:928-958 compares a stored gate environment hash to the current consumer process rather than treating it as immutable gate provenance.

Disposable-repository reproduction: after P adoption, returning to M and running integrate-gate succeeded and set finalized=false/history=1; returning to P made close-prepare fail finalization validation and even another gate at M fail before mutation. In a separate P-adopted repo, changing only TERM_SESSION_ID made both close-prepare and integrate-gate fail fresh-gate validation.
findings.contract_assessment: This breaks T05L-AC2 fresh-process resume and T05L-AC3 mandatory C->M->P->E->H. The record fails closed but cannot use any supported command to recover.
findings.required_change: Split live evidence readiness from frozen artifact-proof validation. At finalize, persist a deterministic finalization identity over M/snapshot, the exact declared gate receipt identities, effective review and verification identities. Gate environment_hash remains stored gate provenance and must not be recomputed from a later consumer process. P/E/H pending and adopted proofs bind that finalization identity and their exact rendered bytes/topology. Once any P/E/H preparation or commit exists, gate/review/verify mutation must refuse rather than invalidate evidence underneath it. Validate adopted commits from their frozen proof, Git parents/tree/path/mode/blob/before/after images and bound finalization identity. Add fresh-process environment-change and post-P evidence-mutation regressions.

evidence: integration.mjs:655-671 keys one record solely by source run id. A prepared record whose integration HEAD moved fails at line 667, while failed records are simply returned; neither has an archive/supersede path.

The accepted correction contract requires a moved integration ref to create a new preparation from the actual tip while retaining the prior attempt (docs/plans/parity-contracts/integration-correction-design.md:33-38). T05C consumes genuine correction records but does not make an ordinary stale clean preparation reusable.
findings.contract_assessment: A failed conflict record remains valid T05C input, but a stale prepared I and a failed record whose actual I changed need an explicit retained supersession; deleting the record manually is not an accepted operation.
findings.required_change: Add a token/hash/revision-bound reprepare operation that requires the same immutable source C/run/approval/scope/common repository, a clean exact current integration tip, and no adopted M/P/E/H. Archive the old base/probe/preparation and recompute the merge-tree, manifests and checkout proofs at current I. Do not overwrite or reinterpret an adopted or actively correcting attempt.

evidence: fingerprintBlob invokes git cat-file per blob; checkout proof validation repeatedly walks the whole tree and live bytes. The asymptotic subprocess concern is concrete, but the receipt supplies no measured repository-size threshold or failed acceptance requirement.
findings.contract_assessment: This is credible scaling debt, not a demonstrated correctness failure in T05L acceptance.
findings.required_change: Add representative performance measurement before assigning release severity; batch object reads if the measured cost is material.

findings.contract_assessment: The frozen source checkout is deliberate lineage evidence through closure, not an accidental two-worktree restriction.
findings.required_change: No code change. Keep the two-checkout workflow documented.

evidence: Bound paths and protected ignored configuration are deliberately included in actual source/M identity so gates cannot execute unreviewed bytes or altered configuration.
findings.contract_assessment: Caches inside declared touches and ignored config-like inputs can affect execution; narrowing them without a new proof would weaken accepted safety.

evidence: review.mjs:26 validates top-level findings, but panel parsing at lines 49-58 derives and returns only member findings without requiring equality. A direct parser probe accepted PASS with an unresolved top-level major and returned findings:[].
findings.contract_assessment: The architecture requires aggregate top-level verdict/findings to be derived from all members and rejects underreported aggregates (architecture-state.md:244-251). Silently discarding a supplied mismatch is inconsistent.
findings.required_change: When panel exists, require canonical normalized top-level findings to equal the member-derived aggregate, or require the supplied top-level array to be empty and document that shape. Add extra/missing/mismatched aggregate tests.

evidence: The fixed 3/2 limits match current policy. Generic merge-base failure handling and missing submodule-object messages can obscure the actionable cause, while submodule deinitialization remains a conservative safe requirement.
findings.contract_assessment: No additional correctness failure was established beyond diagnostics and operational friction.
findings.required_change: Distinguish Git query errors from a negative ancestor result and improve missing-object/deinit guidance in a later bounded maintenance task.

summary: Packet02 finding 1 is a confirmed release-blocking T05L recovery defect. Finding 2 is a confirmed major stale-preparation recovery gap and finding 7 a confirmed minor receipt-consistency bug. Findings 4-6 implement explicit contracts; findings 3 and 8 are unmeasured performance or diagnostic concerns.
